commands_run.command: cd backend; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests -q

design_decisions.decision: Router prefix "/api" rather than editing each decorator path; rejected repeating "/api/logs" literals.
FRONTEND_DIR constant in models.py beside PROJECT_ROOT; rejected recomputing the path in main.py.
Explicit FileResponse route for "/" rather than StaticFiles(html=True) at root, which would shadow routes.

implementation.self_critique: Old-path 404 relies on no catch-all route; verified by test. Pre-existing empty uploads/ dir remains (required by test_real_paths_untouched); no db or cache files found.
